title: Data Quality for AI Agents: Garbage In, Garbage Out Still Applies
author: Jason D.
excerpt: The model is only as good as its inputs. Here's how to audit data quality before your agent ever sees production traffic.
content:
We've audited dozens of AI agents. The single most common root cause of poor performance? Not the model. Not the prompts. The data.

The Data Quality Audit

Before your agent goes to production, audit the data it will process:

Completeness

What percentage of required fields are populated? Missing data is the #1 cause of agent errors.

Consistency

Are the same concepts represented the same way? (e.g., "US", "USA", "United States" all meaning the same thing)

Timeliness

How fresh is the data? Stale data leads to outdated decisions.

Accuracy

Is the data actually correct? Sample and verify.

# data_quality_report.yaml
fields_audited: 12
completeness: 87%      # Target: > 95%
consistency: 72%       # Target: > 90%  (NEEDS WORK)
timeliness: 95%        # Target: > 90%
accuracy: 91%          # Target: > 95%

verdict: NOT READY - consistency issues in 3 fields

Common Data Problems

  • Free-text fields with no validation — Users type anything, agents struggle to parse it
  • Duplicate records — Agent processes the same item twice
  • Stale integrations — Data from connected systems is hours or days old
  • Encoding issues — Character set problems that break parsing

Fixing data quality isn't glamorous, but it delivers more performance improvement than any model upgrade. Every time.

The Bottom Line

Audit your data before you blame your model. Fix completeness and consistency first. Then measure agent performance again. You'll be surprised how much improves.
